title: Walrus Sites — Publishing Frontends as Sui Objects
summary: Port `publish.sh` to TypeScript: validate publish inputs, build the `site-builder` argv, parse the site_object_id out of stdout, then construct the SuiNS link Move call that points a name at the new site. Replaces the IPNS + Cloudflare gateway stack with one Sui object and one SuiNS transaction.
